about.title: Multidisciplinary product designer.
about.intro: Tanaka Matsimbi is a multidisciplinary product designer working across product development, CAD engineering, visualization, and animation. He combines precise modeling with clear communication through exploration and iteration. TMProductLab connects these disciplines from concept to presentation. Open to projects, employment, and creative collaboration.
about.missionTitle: Bridge the gap between concept and creation.
missionParagraphs: Develop ideas into technically viable, visually engaging outcomes.
Bring collaborators together as projects grow, with a shared approach across disciplines.
about.principlesTitle: A clear method behind every discipline.

principles.title: Function meets creativity
principles.copy: Ideas must work and communicate clearly.
principles.detail: Balance practical use with character and clear presentation.

principles.title: Precision-driven
principles.copy: Geometry, proportion, and presentation are controlled with intent.
principles.detail: Carry accuracy from CAD decisions to final outputs.

principles.title: Modular thinking
principles.copy: Systems are designed to adapt, combine, and evolve.
principles.detail: Build flexible systems that welcome new disciplines and collaborators.

principles.title: Iterative refinement
principles.copy: Testing and revision are part of the outcome, not an afterthought.
principles.detail: Use feedback and technical evidence to improve each version.
